description: Unbabel is an AI-powered translation platform for customer experience that combines neural machine translation with a community of professional editors to deliver fast, high-quality translations for customer support, marketing, and product content. It specializes in helping global brands deliver consistent multilingual customer experiences.

name: Translated
description: Translated provides AI-powered professional translation services combining neural machine translation with human expertise. It supports over 200 languages and serves major technology companies with scalable localization solutions.

name: Weglot
description: Weglot is an AI-powered website translation solution that detects and translates website content automatically, then serves translated versions via subdomains or subdirectories. It integrates with all major CMS platforms including WordPress, Shopify, and Webflow.

name: Transifex
description: Transifex is a cloud-based localization platform that uses AI to accelerate translation workflows for software, websites, and mobile apps. It provides translation memory, machine translation integration, and collaboration tools for localization teams.

name: Crowdin
description: Crowdin is an AI-powered localization management platform that helps development teams translate software, mobile apps, and documentation efficiently. It features machine translation engines, translation memory, and integrations with popular development tools like GitHub and Jira.

name: Lilt
description: Lilt is an enterprise AI translation platform that combines adaptive machine translation with human linguists to deliver high-quality translations at scale. It uses a proprietary AI engine that learns from translator corrections to continuously improve output quality.

name: Trados (RWS)
description: Trados by RWS is the industry-leading computer-assisted translation (CAT) tool that combines AI-powered translation memory, terminology management, and machine translation to accelerate professional translation workflows. It is widely used by professional translators and localization teams worldwide.

name: MemoQ
description: MemoQ is a professional computer-assisted translation environment that integrates AI-powered translation memory, terminology management, and machine translation plugins. It is widely adopted by translation agencies and enterprise localization teams for collaborative translation projects.

name: Wordfast
description: Wordfast is a translation memory tool and computer-assisted translation platform available as a desktop application, web app, and Microsoft Word plugin. It helps professional translators improve productivity using translation memories and terminology databases.

name: MateCat
description: MateCat is a free, open-source web-based computer-assisted translation tool that integrates machine translation engines and translation memory to speed up professional translation. It is developed by Translated and allows translators to work on projects directly in the browser.

name: Lingvanex
description: Lingvanex is an AI-powered translation API and platform that provides machine translation across 100+ languages for applications, documents, and websites. It offers on-premise deployment options for organizations requiring data privacy and security compliance.

name: Reverso
description: Reverso is an AI-powered translation and language learning tool that provides contextual translations with real-world usage examples from its large bilingual corpus. It supports translation, conjugation, spell checking, and vocabulary learning across 20+ languages.

name: Linguee
description: Linguee is an AI translation dictionary and search engine that finds translations by searching a vast database of bilingual texts from the web, showing how words and phrases are used in real-world context. It is particularly useful for finding idiomatic expressions and technical terminology.

name: Yandex Translate
description: Yandex Translate is an AI-powered machine translation service that supports 100+ languages and offers text, document, and image translation. It is developed by Yandex and provides a free API for developers to integrate translation into their applications.

name: Systran
description: Systran is a pioneer AI translation platform providing neural machine translation solutions for enterprises and government agencies, with both cloud and on-premise deployment options. It specializes in domain-specific translation models for industries like legal, defense, and technology.

name: TextUnited
description: TextUnited is an AI-powered translation management platform that combines machine translation, translation memory, and human translators in a unified workflow for businesses. It supports automated project creation, glossary management, and integrations with popular CMS and development tools.

name: Fortinet FortiAI
description: Fortinet FortiAI is an AI-powered security assistant embedded in the Fortinet Security Fabric that uses generative AI to help security teams investigate threats, write automation scripts, and understand network security posture. It integrates across Fortinet's product portfolio to accelerate SOC operations.

name: Anomali
description: Anomali is an AI-powered threat intelligence platform that correlates threat data with security logs to detect and respond to cyberattacks faster. It aggregates indicators of compromise from hundreds of threat feeds and enriches SIEM data with actionable intelligence.

name: Swimlane
description: Swimlane is an AI-powered security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR) platform that uses low-code automation to help security teams reduce alert volume and accelerate incident response. Its Turbine AI engine enables complex security workflows to run at machine speed.

name: Checkmarx
description: Checkmarx is an AI-powered application security testing platform that provides comprehensive SAST, DAST, SCA, and API security testing in a unified platform. Its AI-driven Codebashing product delivers developer security training contextualized to identified vulnerabilities.

name: AutoGPT
description: AutoGPT is an open-source autonomous AI agent that chains GPT-4 calls to complete complex, multi-step tasks without continuous human oversight. It can browse the web, write and execute code, manage files, and interact with external services to accomplish user-defined goals.

name: CrewAI
description: CrewAI is an open-source framework for orchestrating role-playing autonomous AI agents that collaborate to accomplish complex tasks. It enables developers to create crews of AI agents with specialized roles, tools, and goals that work together in structured workflows.

name: Autogen (Microsoft)
description: Microsoft AutoGen is an open-source framework for building multi-agent AI systems where autonomous agents can converse with each other and with humans to solve tasks collaboratively. It simplifies the creation of complex LLM workflows with customizable agent behaviors and conversation patterns.

name: SuperAGI
description: SuperAGI is an open-source infrastructure platform for building and deploying autonomous AI agents, providing a visual GUI, agent marketplace, and tools for memory management. It allows teams to run multiple agents concurrently and monitor their performance in real time.

name: MetaGPT
description: MetaGPT is an open-source multi-agent meta programming framework that assigns different roles to GPT agents to collaboratively develop software. It simulates a software company with agents acting as product manager, architect, engineer, and QA to produce entire codebases from a single requirement description.

name: ChatDev
description: ChatDev is an open-source virtual software company driven by LLM-powered agents that simulate different roles such as CEO, CTO, programmer, and tester to collaboratively create software. It uses structured chat workflows where agents communicate to design, code, test, and document complete applications.

name: Lindy AI
description: Lindy AI is a no-code AI employee platform that lets users create autonomous AI agents called Lindies to automate repetitive business tasks like email management, scheduling, and CRM updates. Lindies can connect to 3,000+ apps and make decisions based on contextual understanding.

name: Relevance AI
description: Relevance AI is a no-code AI agent builder platform that enables businesses to create custom AI agents and multi-agent teams to automate sales, support, research, and operations workflows. Its visual builder allows non-technical users to chain AI tools and integrations without writing code.

name: Flowise
description: Flowise is an open-source drag-and-drop UI tool for building LLM-powered applications and AI agent workflows using LangChain and LlamaIndex components. It enables developers to visually design chatbots, document QA systems, and agentic pipelines and deploy them as APIs.

name: Dify
description: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform that combines visual workflow orchestration, RAG pipeline building, and AI agent creation in a unified interface. It supports deployment of production-ready AI applications with monitoring, version control, and team collaboration features.

name: Langflow
description: Langflow is an open-source visual workflow builder for creating AI pipelines and agents using LangChain components through a drag-and-drop interface. It enables rapid prototyping of RAG applications, multi-agent systems, and LLM workflows without extensive coding.

name: Pipedream
description: Pipedream is a serverless integration and automation platform that lets developers build workflows connecting APIs, databases, and AI models with code or a visual builder. It provides pre-built components for 1,000+ apps and supports real-time event-driven automation triggered by webhooks, schedules, or API events.

name: Activepieces
description: Activepieces is an open-source automation platform that provides a no-code interface for building workflows that connect popular apps and services. It is designed as a self-hostable alternative to Zapier and Make, with an extensible pieces framework for custom integrations.

name: Huginn
description: Huginn is an open-source system for building agents that monitor the web and automate tasks on your behalf, similar to a self-hosted IFTTT or Zapier. It can track websites, fetch data from APIs, send notifications, and chain complex automated workflows through a visual interface.

name: Temporal
description: Temporal is an open-source workflow orchestration platform that makes it easy to build reliable, scalable distributed applications with durable execution guarantees. It enables developers to write workflows as code with automatic retry, state persistence, and fault tolerance built in.

name: Prefect
description: Prefect is a modern data workflow orchestration platform that enables data engineers to build, schedule, and monitor reliable data pipelines in Python. It provides automatic retries, caching, and real-time observability for both simple scripts and complex multi-step data workflows.

name: Dagster
description: Dagster is an open-source data orchestration platform designed for developing and maintaining data assets with lineage, observability, and reliability. It treats data pipelines as software assets with declarative definitions, making data engineering workflows testable and maintainable.

name: Apache Airflow
description: Apache Airflow is the leading open-source workflow orchestration platform that enables data engineers to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor complex data pipelines using Python DAGs. It is widely deployed by data teams worldwide for orchestrating ETL processes, ML pipelines, and operational workflows.

name: Retool
description: Retool is an AI-powered platform for building internal business tools by connecting to databases, APIs, and services with a visual drag-and-drop interface. It enables developers to build custom admin panels, dashboards, and operational workflows without full custom development.

name: Appsmith
description: Appsmith is an open-source low-code platform for building custom internal tools, admin panels, and CRUD apps by connecting to any database or API. It provides a drag-and-drop builder with JavaScript customization, allowing teams to create production-grade internal applications rapidly.

name: Budibase
description: Budibase is an open-source low-code platform for building internal business tools, workflows, and CRUD apps with automation capabilities. It supports self-hosting, custom data sources, role-based access control, and built-in automation to rapidly build and deploy operational tools.

name: Tooljet
description: ToolJet is an open-source low-code platform for building internal business applications with a visual drag-and-drop builder that connects to databases, APIs, and cloud storage. It supports complex UI components, JavaScript customization, and workflow automation for building enterprise-grade internal tools.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
description: Cloudflare Workers AI is an edge AI inference platform that runs AI models at Cloudflare's global network, enabling developers to run LLMs, image generation, and other AI tasks with ultra-low latency close to end users. It provides a serverless AI runtime integrated with Cloudflare's developer ecosystem.

name: Buffer
description: Buffer is an AI-powered social media management platform for scheduling posts, analyzing performance, and engaging with audiences across Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Pinterest. Its AI assistant helps create and repurpose content while providing analytics to optimize posting times.

name: Hootsuite
description: Hootsuite is a comprehensive AI-powered social media management platform that enables organizations to schedule content, monitor brand mentions, analyze performance, and manage multiple social profiles from a unified dashboard. Its OwlyWriter AI generates social captions and content ideas.

name: Sprout Social
description: Sprout Social is an AI-powered social media management platform providing scheduling, social listening, analytics, and customer care tools for brands and agencies. Its AI-driven features include sentiment analysis, predictive best send times, and content performance forecasting.

name: Later
description: Later is an AI-powered social media scheduling and analytics platform focused on visual content planning for Instagram, TikTok, and other social networks. Its visual content calendar, link-in-bio tools, and AI caption writer help creators and brands plan and publish engaging content.

name: Planoly
description: Planoly is an AI-powered visual social media planner and scheduler designed for Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and other visual platforms. It provides a drag-and-drop grid planner, AI caption generation, and analytics tools for brands and creators focused on aesthetic content.

name: Socialbee
description: SocialBee is an AI-powered social media management tool with content categorization features that help businesses maintain a balanced social media posting strategy. Its AI content generation creates posts tailored to brand voice, while content categories ensure diverse, evergreen posting schedules.

name: Publer
description: Publer is an AI-powered social media scheduling and collaboration tool that supports Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google Business, Pinterest, YouTube, and Telegram. Its AI Assist feature generates captions, hashtags, and content ideas directly within the scheduling workflow.

name: CoSchedule
description: CoSchedule is an AI-powered marketing calendar and social media scheduling platform that centralizes all marketing activities in a unified content calendar. Its AI Headline Studio analyzes and scores headline quality, while the marketing calendar integrates social, email, and content workflows.

name: Agorapulse
description: Agorapulse is an AI-powered social media management platform with scheduling, inbox management, social listening, and reporting features for teams and agencies. Its shared social inbox centralizes all comments, messages, and mentions, enabling efficient team collaboration on customer responses.

name: Sendible
description: Sendible is an AI-powered social media management tool designed for agencies and teams, providing scheduling, brand monitoring, and detailed analytics across all major social platforms. Its Canva integration and content suggestion features streamline the social content creation workflow.

name: SocialPilot
description: SocialPilot is an AI-powered social media management tool for small businesses and agencies, offering scheduling, content curation, team collaboration, and analytics at an affordable price. Its AI assistant generates captions and content ideas while the bulk scheduling feature streamlines large-volume posting.

name: Loomly
description: Loomly is an AI-powered brand success platform that provides a content calendar, post optimization tips, post builder, and detailed analytics for social media teams. It offers automated post ideas based on trending topics and best practices, along with approval workflows for team collaboration.

name: Tailwind
description: Tailwind is an AI-powered social media scheduling and marketing tool specialized for Pinterest and Instagram, offering SmartSchedule for optimal posting times and Ghostwriter AI for caption creation. Its Create tool generates on-brand post designs automatically from brand assets.

name: Predis.ai
description: Predis.ai is an AI-powered social media content creation and scheduling platform that generates complete posts including text, images, and hashtags from a single keyword or topic input. It supports creation for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other platforms with brand-consistent styling.

name: Lately
description: Lately is an AI-powered social media content platform that uses neural networks trained on high-performing content to generate engaging social posts from long-form content like blogs, videos, and podcasts. It automatically repurposes existing content into dozens of social media-ready snippets.

name: Flick
description: Flick is an AI-powered social media marketing platform that specializes in hashtag research, AI content creation, and post scheduling for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Facebook. Its AI Social Media Marketing Assistant generates content strategies, captions, and hashtag sets tailored to brand voice.

name: Ocoya
description: Ocoya is an AI-powered social media management platform that combines content creation, scheduling, and analytics with a built-in graphic design tool and AI copywriting. It enables teams to create on-brand social posts with AI-generated captions and visuals and schedule them across multiple platforms.

name: ContentStudio
description: ContentStudio is an AI-powered content marketing and social media management platform that combines content discovery, creation, scheduling, and analytics in one tool. Its AI composer generates social captions and blog posts, while content discovery surfaces trending topics relevant to any industry.

name: Missinglettr
description: Missinglettr is an AI-powered social media automation tool that automatically creates year-long social media campaigns from blog posts, extracting key quotes and images to generate a drip campaign of social content. It is particularly useful for bloggers and content marketers who want to maximize content reach.

name: Taplio
description: Taplio is an AI-powered LinkedIn growth tool that helps professionals create high-performing content, schedule posts, engage with their network, and track analytics on LinkedIn. Its AI generates posts based on high-performing content in any industry and provides a personal CRM for LinkedIn networking.

name: AuthoredUp
description: AuthoredUp is an AI-powered LinkedIn content creation and analytics tool that helps creators write better posts with formatting tools, post templates, and a content library. It provides detailed analytics on post performance, follower growth, and engagement metrics for LinkedIn creators.

name: Repurpose.io
description: Repurpose.io is an AI-powered content repurposing and distribution platform that automatically converts podcast episodes, YouTube videos, and blog posts into short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook, and other social platforms. It streamlines the multi-platform content distribution workflow.

name: Canva Social
description: Canva Social is the social media scheduling and publishing feature within Canva that allows users to create, schedule, and publish social media posts across multiple platforms directly from the Canva design environment. It combines Canva's AI design tools with social media publishing in one workflow.

name: Pablo by Buffer
description: Pablo by Buffer is a free, simple online tool for creating social media images quickly with text overlays on photos from a curated library. It is designed for quick social media image creation without needing design skills, and integrates directly with Buffer for immediate scheduling.

name: Crello (VistaCreate)
description: VistaCreate (formerly Crello) is an AI-powered graphic design platform for creating animated and static social media content, presentations, and marketing materials using a large library of templates and assets. It provides a Canva-like experience with animation capabilities and brand kit management.

name: Stencil
description: Stencil is a fast, simple graphic design tool for creating social media graphics, blog images, and marketing visuals using thousands of templates and a large stock photo library. It is designed for marketers and bloggers who need to create professional-quality social images quickly without design expertise.

name: Rechat
description: Rechat is an AI-powered real estate CRM and marketing platform designed for real estate agents and brokerages, combining contact management, marketing automation, and transaction coordination. Its AI provides personalized follow-up recommendations and automates client communication workflows.

name: kvCORE
description: kvCORE is an AI-powered real estate platform for agents, teams, and brokerages that combines a website, CRM, lead generation, and marketing automation in one system. Its AI behavioral engine automatically nurtures leads with intelligent follow-up based on prospect behavior and engagement signals.

name: Offrs
description: Offrs is a predictive analytics platform for real estate that uses AI to identify homeowners most likely to sell within the next 12 months in any given territory. It provides agents with exclusive seller leads and automated marketing tools to connect with potential sellers before they list.

name: Cotality
description: CoreLogic is a leading provider of AI-powered property data, analytics, and services for the real estate and mortgage industries. It offers property data for 99% of US parcels and provides AI-driven analytics for valuations, risk assessment, fraud detection, and market intelligence.

name: Inside Real Estate
description: Inside Real Estate provides the kvCORE platform and related AI-powered solutions for agents, teams, and brokerages, focusing on intelligent lead management and marketing automation. Its AI behavioral system engages leads across multiple channels to maximize conversion rates.

name: Wrike AI
description: Wrike is an AI-powered project management and work collaboration platform that provides real-time visibility, AI-generated project insights, and automation for complex team workflows. Its Work Intelligence AI features include risk prediction, smart task automation, and AI-powered project summaries.

name: Smartsheet AI
description: Smartsheet is an enterprise AI-powered work management platform that combines spreadsheet-like interfaces with project management, workflow automation, and reporting capabilities. Its AI features include formula generation, content creation, and automated data extraction from documents.

name: PDF.ai
description: PDF.ai is an AI-powered PDF interaction tool that allows users to chat with their PDF documents to extract information, get summaries, and ask specific questions. It supports large documents and multiple PDFs simultaneously, making it useful for research and professional document analysis.

name: Docalysis
description: Docalysis is an AI-powered document analysis tool that enables users to upload PDFs and other documents and ask questions to quickly extract key information and insights. It is designed for professionals who need to analyze large volumes of documents efficiently.

name: Sharly AI
description: Sharly AI is an AI document summarization and question-answering tool that helps professionals quickly extract insights from PDFs, reports, and documents. It supports uploading multiple documents and asking cross-document questions, making it useful for research and competitive analysis.

name: LightPDF AI
description: LightPDF is an AI-powered PDF solution that provides chat with PDF, document translation, OCR, editing, and conversion tools in a unified platform. Its AI assistant can answer questions about document content and summarize long documents across multiple languages.

name: Smallpdf AI
description: Smallpdf is an AI-powered online PDF toolset offering compression, conversion, editing, signing, and chat-with-PDF capabilities in a simple interface. Its AI PDF summarizer and chat feature allow users to quickly understand and interact with documents without reading them in full.

name: iLovePDF
description: iLovePDF is a comprehensive online PDF tool suite that provides over 20 tools for merging, splitting, compressing, converting, and editing PDF files, with AI-powered features for document summarization and organization. It is widely used by individuals and businesses for everyday PDF workflow tasks.

name: DocSend
description: DocSend is an AI-powered secure document sharing and analytics platform that provides real-time insights into how recipients engage with shared documents, including time spent per page and viewer identity. It is widely used by sales teams and startups to share pitch decks and proposals with tracking.

name: Docusaurus
description: Docusaurus is an open-source documentation website builder by Meta that makes it easy to create, maintain, and publish documentation sites from Markdown files. It provides versioning, internationalization, search, and theming capabilities for technical product documentation.

name: Swagger/OpenAPI
description: Swagger (now SmartBear) is the world's most widely used API documentation and design toolset, built around the OpenAPI specification standard. It provides tools for designing, building, documenting, and testing REST APIs with auto-generated interactive documentation.

name: Agora
description: Agora is a real-time voice, video, and interactive live streaming API platform that powers in-app communication features for social, gaming, education, and enterprise applications. It provides low-latency, high-quality audio and video infrastructure with AI-powered features like noise suppression.

name: LiveKit
description: LiveKit is an open-source WebRTC infrastructure platform for building real-time audio, video, and data applications at scale, commonly used for building AI voice agents and multi-party video applications. It provides server-side media processing, AI agent integration, and scalable media routing.

name: Daily
description: Daily.co is a WebRTC video API platform that provides reliable, low-latency video and audio infrastructure for embedding calls into web and mobile applications. It offers a complete video SDK with screen sharing, recording, custom layouts, and prebuilt UI components.

name: Whereby
description: Whereby is a simple, browser-based video conferencing platform that requires no downloads or account creation for guests and provides persistent meeting rooms with custom URLs. It is popular for small teams, tutors, and customer-facing video meetings.

name: Zoom AI Companion
description: Zoom AI Companion is Zoom's built-in generative AI assistant that provides meeting summaries, action item extraction, in-meeting question answering, and chat composition across Zoom Meetings, Team Chat, and Phone. It is included at no additional cost for paid Zoom users.

name: Microsoft Teams AI
description: Microsoft Teams with Copilot AI provides enterprise collaboration with AI-powered meeting summaries, chat assistance, and intelligent search across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Teams AI includes Copilot for summarizing conversations, generating meeting notes, and automating tasks within chats.

name: Slack AI
description: Slack with Slack AI provides enterprise team messaging with AI-powered channel summaries, thread recaps, search answers, and workflow automation. Its AI features help teams catch up on missed conversations quickly and find information across the organization's Slack history.

name: Gather
description: Gather is an AI-powered virtual office platform that recreates the spontaneous collaboration of in-person offices through a 2D spatial video chat environment. Teams can move around a virtual office floor plan and initiate video conversations by walking up to colleagues' avatars.

name: Tandem
description: Tandem is an AI-powered virtual office app that enables remote teams to see who's available and jump into conversations with one click, mimicking the spontaneous communication of co-located teams. It integrates with other tools and shows real-time status across the team's virtual office.

name: Auferet
description: Auferet is an AI game master for solo text adventures and tabletop-style RPGs. It keeps a persistent memory of your story and lets you upload your own lore, so the world stays consistent across long sessions. Plays in the browser and on Android, with dedicated D&D 5e and Pathfinder 2e modes.

name: Recapo.ai
description: Recapo.ai is an AI video editing platform that turns long-form video into publish-ready short clips. It understands long footage to generate plot summaries and highlights, drafts scripts, adds synchronized subtitles and AI voiceover, and exports vertical clips for TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts. It offers dedicated modes for film and TV recaps, talking-head clips with speaker focus, and product promos that match A-roll with B-roll, plus batch generation and cloud rendering.

name: FPVTune
description: FPVTune is an AI assistant for FPV drone pilots that uses a neural network to analyze Betaflight blackbox logs and suggest practical PID and filter tuning changes.

name: Image Describer
description: Image Describer is an AI tool that turns an uploaded image into text, generating descriptions, WCAG-oriented alt text, OCR extractions, image-to-prompt output, and social captions.

name: Blur Background
description: Blur Background is a photo tool from Vignra that blurs image backgrounds while keeping the subject sharp, running its free tier locally in the browser with an optional AI-assisted subject mask.

name: Video Upscaler
description: Video Upscaler is an online AI video enhancer that upscales low-resolution footage to HD or 4K, applying restoration, denoising, and sharpening through a credit-based workflow.

name: Sharpniq
description: Sharpniq removes blur from photos in the browser, running the model on your own device so the image is never uploaded, with an optional paid mode that processes larger files on its servers.
